source: 3DSC (SuperCon x Materials Project), aimat-lab/3DSC, Scientific Data 2023
bi2pd_note: Bi2Pd in 3DSC: C2/m (2/m) and I213 (23), both EXCLUDED. Article 12.2 cites Fd-3m 227 (Oh, candidate). Phase assignment needs experimental clarification.
chevel_note: Chevrel phases in 3DSC use MP structures (P3/P1) lower than experimental R-3 (148); verdict affected by structure-source artifact.
caveat_mp_structure: 3DSC uses MP DFT-relaxed structures; a few cuprates appear as R-3m/Im-3m (MP representation artifacts) and are CANDIDATE, while experimental cuprates are orthorhombic/tetragonal (EXCLUDED). Verdicts should be re-checked against experimental structures.
